subject.title: fix(googlechat): media downloads can grow unbounded without a size cap

question: Should the Google Chat media helper fail closed at the documented 20 MiB default when direct callers omit `maxBytes`?
rationale: The patch fixes unbounded external-response buffering, but it changes exported helper behavior from uncapped to capped for omitted `maxBytes`, so maintainer intent should decide that compatibility contract before merge.

options.title: Accept the 20 MiB helper default
options.body: Land this patch with the documented Google Chat media default and require direct callers that need larger media to pass an explicit `maxBytes`.

options.title: Pause for a different API contract
options.body: Hold the PR if omitted `maxBytes` should keep another public meaning, then document and test that contract before landing.

recommendation.title: Accept the 20 MiB helper default
recommendation.body: Land this patch with the documented Google Chat media default and require direct callers that need larger media to pass an explicit `maxBytes`.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the cap-alignment commit and framed the branch as ready for the serialized landing slot.
